messages:
Marta (People Ops): Quick sync 1 Anita Weber (final loop) is in Berlin, prefers German Sign Language (DGS) interpreter for behavioral + system design. She also needs hotel for overnight since her flight arrives late.
Ethan (Recruiter): Thanks. Anita can do Mon 09:30 PT (18:30 CET) for the loop. Roland, is that start ok?
Roland (Hiring Manager): 09:30 PT works. Panel will join remotely; will rearrange one engineer to start earlier. Proposed flow: 09:30-10:15 technical, 10:15-11:00 break & take-home, 11:00-11:45 system design, 11:45-12:00 internal debrief.
Marta (People Ops): Interpreter vendor suggestion: SignNow GmbH (Berlin) quotes E425 for two 1h sessions plus travel. @ExpenseBot can you preapprove? We also need NDA signed before take-home.
ExpenseBot: Preapproval check: external interpreter vendor approved up to 500 EUR for hiring ops events. Please attach vendor invoice for reimbursement.
Ethan (Recruiter): I'll send DocuSign NDA now. Also flag that Anita asked whether Redwood books hotel or we reimburse; policy: we can book up to 2 nights for international candidates traveling >5 hours. She prefers near campus.
Marta (People Ops): We'll book a room for Mon/Tue (1 night) and cover taxi from SFO. Facilities, can you reserve a guest parking pass and arrange airport pickup if needed?
Facilities: Guest room block reserved at Redwood Partner Hotel (walking distance). Airport pickup can be arranged on request; will hold one parking pass (Lot G) for Anita.
Ethan (Recruiter): Anita confirmed DGS is required only for the behavioral and system design segments. She can do technical without interpreter. Phone +49 171 555 0101.
Marta (People Ops): Noted. IT: candidate requested a loaner dev laptop with an RTX-class GPU for the take-home ML mini-benchmark (Docker + CUDA). Any availability?
ITAssetBot: Reserved 1x Dell Precision with RTX 3080 (Loan-EU-0099) from EMEA pool. Will ship to SF office and place in guest locker for pickup. Return label included.
OnboardingBot: Background check: identity verification complete; employment reference checks pending. No blocking flags.
Roland (Hiring Manager): For the take-home, set repo expiry to 6h and require the candidate to upload results to the private S3 link. Also ask panel to avoid technical jargon during interpretered session.
Ethan (Recruiter): Will include instructions and set repo expiry. Also will note interpreter timing in invites. Draft candidate message below 1 send?
Anita (Candidate): Confirmed. Thank you for arranging interpreter and hotel. I will sign NDA now. One ask: can breakfast be vegetarian/vegan?
Marta (People Ops): Yes. We'll add vegetarian/vegan breakfast to booking. Also will include quiet low-sensory room note in the event.
Ethan (Recruiter): DocuSign sent; Anita signed within 1h. Calendar invite draft for internal copy below 
```
Title: Redwood Final Loop 2 Anita Weber (SWE)
When: Mon 09:30-12:00 PT / 18:30-21:00 CET
Where: Zoom (interpreter joins for behavioral + system design) + Guest loaner pickup at SF Reception (Loan-EU-0099)
Agenda: 09:30-10:15 Tech (no interpreter), 10:15-11:00 Break & take-home task (repo link sent post-10:15), 11:00-11:45 System design (DGS interpreter present), 11:45-12:00 Panel debrief (internal)
Notes: DGS interpreter arranged (SignNow GmbH). Hotel booked (1 night) near campus; taxi covered. NDA signed; private repo expires in 6h. Candidate phone +49 171 555 0101. Vegetarian breakfast requested.
Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/anita-final
```
Marta (People Ops): Final asks: attach interpreter vendor invoice to Expense, IT to confirm loaner in guest locker, Facilities to add parking code and pickup instructions to the invite. After loop remind panel: submit Greenhouse scorecards within 24h and note interpreter observations separately. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
